BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6251.name: Lou-Koutyu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6251.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending two cores from your Reserve to your Trash, the opponent can't activate their Bursts.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10879.name: The HornetKing Fong-Need
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10879.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put three cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When the opposing Life is reduced, by sending three cores from this Spirit to your Trash, refresh this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11245.name: The Little Samurai Issun Antman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11245.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
By returning a Spirit with [High Speed]/[Windstorm] you control to the Hand, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
At the start of the step, by exhausting this Spirit, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11333.name: The MagicalPrincessDeity Geraldy
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11333.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 2/3/4] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 2/3/4 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When any Magic card is discarded from your deck by an opposing Spirit effect, during this turn, cards can't be discarded from your deck.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
By returning a card from your Trash to the deckbottom, send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12867.name: The SuperEmperor Siegpentan-Nova
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12867.effect:
[Tribute: Song Bird → Void]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all core from a "Song Bird" family Spirit you control to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If "The Kaiser Empereur" was used for the [Tribute], summon any number of "Pentan"-named Spirit cards from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. However, the (When Summoned) effects of those Spirits can't activate.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying three "Pentan"-named Spirits you control, this Spirit refreshes.
